name: unifi
description: Read and manage a UniFi Network console through the official integration API, with an API key. Includes skills for a health check, a firewall audit, client troubleshooting, and firewall changes.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The API key from UniFi Network, in Settings > Control Plane > Integrations. A read-only key is sufficient unless you allow changes.

host.title: Console host
host.description: The IP address or hostname of a local console, for example 192.168.1.1. Set exactly one of the console host, the console ID, or the base URL.

consoleId.title: Console ID
consoleId.description: The console ID from unifi.ui.com. The server then connects through the UniFi cloud connector.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Any other URL that ends in /proxy/network/integration.

verifyTls.title: Verify the TLS certificate
verifyTls.description: A local console usually has a self-signed certificate. Turn this off only on a network that you trust.

defaultSiteId.title: Default site ID
defaultSiteId.description: The site to use when a tool call has no site ID. You do not need it if the console has only one site.

allowWrites.title: Allow changes
allowWrites.description: Add the tools that change the network, such as firewall policies, device restarts, and vouchers. The API key must have write access.
